 Barcelona W vs Servette Geneve FC W 
 Where to Watch Barcelona W vs Servette Geneve FC W Live - TV Channels Info
 Sportsdunia Desk Published -  Nov 19, 2026, 05:00 PM 4 min comment Add on As Preferred Source UEFA Women's Champions League Barcelona W Summary
 Fixture: Barcelona Femení welcomes Servette Geneve FC Women for a league game in the UEFA Women's Champions League.
 Streaming Guide: Fancode holds the exclusive rights to UWCL matches in the Indian Subcontinent. ESPN Deportes, Paramount+, and fuboTV are the streaming options in the US, while Disney+ Premium is the go-to platform across Europe.
 Match Context: The hosts are looking to get back to winning ways after a disappointing draw against Arsenal, while Servette are also coming off a 1-2 defeat over Italian giants Roma.
 Match Overview & Facts
 Fixture : Barcelona W vs Servette Geneve FC W (UEFA Champions League Women - League Phase)
 Date & Kick-Off : Thursday, November 19, 2026 | 20:00 GMT / 15:00 EST (US) / 21:00 CET (Spain & Switzerland) / 01:30 IST (Nov 20)
 Venue : Estadi Johan Cruyff, Barcelona
 Prediction : Barcelona Femení 5-0 
 Broadcasters : ESPN Deportes / CBS Sports Golazo (US), Disney+ Premium (Europe), Blue Sport / RTS (Switzerland), and FanCode (India).

 Where to Watch Barcelona W vs Servette Geneve FC W Advertisement
 Swiss winners Servette Geneve FC face a daunting task as they prepare to face reigning holders Barcelona away. The hosts, meanwhile, will be looking for an emphatic response after a 1-1 stalemate with Arsenal halted their unbeaten run in the UEFA Women's Champions League .
 Although the result confirmed their progression to the knockouts, the Catalans endured a difficult night last time around. The game was also the first time Pere Romeu's side scored fewer than five goals in Europe this season.
 Caroline Graham Hansen cancelled a Frida Maanum opener that gave the Gunners the lead midway through the first half. Barcelona will be disappointed with the Arsenal draw and would like to thump their authority in Europe with a crushing win over the Swiss visitors.
 Servette Geneve , on the other hand, have won just once in their four games in the UWCL. The Swiss holders had thumped Leuven W by a 5-1 scoreline in their only win of the tournament.
 They lie just two places outside the 1/8 finals playoff spot with three points. Many Blaugrana fans are looking ahead to the contest, asking where to watch Barcelona W vs Servette Geneve FC W live.
 Find the television listings and live stream options for the clash in this brief channel guide.
 Barcelona W vs Servette Geneve FC W TV Telecast & Cable Details
 Fans from Switzerland wondering where to watch Barcelona W vs Servette Geneve FC W live on TV can watch the live telecast on RTS and Sunrise TV. The regional service providers will televise the game live on RTS 2 and RTS Sport.
 Viewers from North America can also catch the action from Barcelona on ESPN Deportes and CBS Sports Golazo. 
 Advertisement
 Barcelona W vs Servette Geneve FC W Live Streaming Options & Free Trial
 Barcelona W vs Servette Geneve FC W live streaming will be available on Disney+ Premium in most corners of the world. Supporters of either club can watch the live coverage on the platform in their respective countries. Swiss fans also have extra options on the digital platforms of Blue Sport and RTS Sport.
 Indian subcontinent followers can watch the UWCL matches on FanCode, while a free trial is also available on fuboTV for North American users. New subscribers to the platform get limited-time access to the channels airing the game.
